text:
sara: T-minus 90 for the staggered rollout (eu -> na). Change window is 00:00-02:00 UTC. Freezing merges for repo `platform` in 10m. Quick checklist: canary, metrics gate, rollback tag, release notes link. Owners please ack.

alex: Ack. Canary prepared in eu-west-1. Using deploy-bot flag --safelock so traffic cutover won't exceed canary %. I'll attach canary config in a sec.

jamal: Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/release/2026-03-21-staggered-rollout (includes client-facing changelog + known issue about embed cache warmup).

deploy-bot: Starting canary run for service `model-service` commit abc123def in eu-west-1. Flags: --safelock --kvcache=on --batch=auto. Canary size: 3% traffic. ETA ~8m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/logs/abc123def

ops-bot: Reminder: merge freeze applied to `platform` main. All PRs set to hold.

tess: Gate thresholds for abort: p50 latency > 120ms OR error_rate > 0.7% for 2 consecutive 1m windows. If either tripped, manual rollback.

alex: Canary config (snippet):
```
canary: 3%
monitoring: latency_ms_p50, error_rate
abort_conditions:
  - latency_p50 > 120ms for 2m
  - error_rate > 0.7% for 2m
fallback: route -> model-service-v2 (quantized)
```

sara: Confirming embeddings-model pinned to v3.2.1 for this window? We saw tokenization variance in staging earlier.

alex: Pinned embeddings-model -> v3.2.1 on all serving pools (eu, na). :white_check_mark:

jamal: FYI I added a short note in the release doc about warmup: "Expect higher token generation cost during first 10 minutes due to cold KV cache; metrics will stabilize after prefix caching warms."

deploy-bot: Canary health update: 4m elapsed. p50=95ms, error_rate=0.12%. No abort triggers.

ops-bot: Alert: small spike in 503s on eu-west-1 edge (0.15% -> 0.9%) at 00:19:23 UTC. Investigating.

alex: Seeing the spike in edge logs, filtering shows a routing mis-match from one LB. Rolling that instance out of the pool.

deploy-bot: Canary paused (manual) at 00:20:06 UTC by alex due to edge spike. No cutover.

tess: Good call. Follow rollback play if spike persists > 2m. Rollback command: `/rollback --service model-service --tag abc123def --to-tag v2026-03-14-stable`

jamal: I pushed a short postmortem note to the release doc about the transient LB routing bug and adjusted the rollout checklist to include LB drain verification.

sara: Team — since canary paused, we will hold the freeze lift until we have a clean canary resumption and the ops postmortem one-liner. Plan: remediate LB, resume canary at 00:40 UTC with same safelock, then evaluate for gradual shift (10% -> 30%). Agree?

alex: Agree. I'll re-run a small dry canary at 00:40 and report metrics in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary resume scheduled: commit abc123def, start 00:40 UTC, canary 1% for 3m then 3% if stable.

ops-bot: LB node replaced and drained. No active 503s for 90s.

deploy-bot: Resume health: 2m elapsed. p50=98ms, error_rate=0.09%. No aborts. Increasing canary to 3%.

alex: Can we get a docs shoutout in #general once we cut to 30%? Jamal, can you prepare a 1-line for customers about transient latency during warmup?

jamal: Yep — ready to post once we reach stable 30%.

sara: Ok, resume went clean. If 30% holds for 10m with no threshold breaches, we proceed to full shift. Freeze lift will be announced after full shift completes.

tess: Reminder: create rollback tag before full shift: `git tag -a v2026-03-21-rollback -m "pre-rollout snapshot"` and push.

alex: Tag created and pushed: v2026-03-21-rollback.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift to 30% initiated. Monitoring windows active.

deploy-bot: 10m check: p50=102ms, error_rate=0.08%. Stable.

sara: Proceed to full shift and then announce freeze lift in 10m after final verification. Great work everyone. :tada:

jamal: Customer note posted to #general: "Rolling out model update — you may see slightly higher latency for a few minutes as caches warm. We're monitoring and will update if anything changes."

ops-bot: Freeze lift scheduled at 01:15 UTC. Will unfreeze `platform` merges after the final confirmation message from sara.

sara: Final: full shift complete, metrics healthy. Freeze lifted for `platform`. Closing thread and filing rollout summary to release docs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
